name.full: CSM Advisor for Microsoft Copilot Cowork

description.short: Customer signals to an evidence-based, role-based skilling plan.
description.full: CSM Advisor helps CSMs, account teams, MTTMs and MTTs turn customer files (Word, PDF, text, PowerPoint, Excel), emails, usage reports and optional Teams meeting recaps into an evidence-based skilling proposal. It runs five stages in one go: collect artifacts, extract signals into a Signals Summary Word document, select an Activate, Deepen, Protect or Convert and Extend path, map each required skill to Microsoft Learn catalog items in a Skills Map Word document, and build a Skilling Paths proposal Word document by audience for MTT review. Debug logging is optional.
